backgroundZh: 李邕叙长沙麓山寺自晋至唐的沿革。文、书、刻素有“三绝”之称。元丰三年（1080），米芾来此学书，名字留在了碑阴。
background: Li Yong’s account of a Changsha monastery from its Jin-dynasty founding to the Tang, praised as a “three excellences” stele for text, calligraphy, and cutting. Mi Fu studied it in 1080 and left his name on the reverse.

review.note: Owner approved for publication on 2026-11-18. Pre-approval evidence note: Draft work record from a local-history page. The cutter’s name is recorded as 黄仙鹤, whom scholars suspect to be Li Yong’s alias; no attribution is asserted for the cutting.
review.noteZh: 项目负责人于 2026-11-18 审核并同意发布。审核前的证据记录：依据地方志平台页面整理的草稿；刻者署「黄仙鹤」，学界疑为李邕化名，故不主张刻者身份。

notes: The page gives the surviving character count only approximately (“1000余字”).
